678-4939-8095.description:
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying its mana cost.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters, it triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Burning-Tree Emissary.
When Burning-Tree Emissary dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Burning-Tree Emissary from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Repeat.

413-1981-2811.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
413-1981-2811.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and by sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Elas il-Kor's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station and Elas il-Kor's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Elas il-Kor trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

643-4881-6909-6974.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
643-4881-6909-6974.description:
Cast Ashling's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

2169-2438-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2169-2438-4694-7306.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1734-3817-3899.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 3.

586-1594-5258-5618-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1978-5159-7826.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Foods.
1978-5159-7826.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creaitng a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature token with haste named Mishra's Warform in addition to its other types.
Activate Mishra's Warform by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mishra's Warform.
Repeat from step 2.

2350-4200-5998-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

215-969-1129.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Allies.
215-969-1129.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Harabaz Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Harabaz Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4311-5078-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
4311-5078-7693.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least one oil counter on it

618-3120-4456-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying at most {1}{R} due to Mindsplice Apparatus.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
618-3120-4456-7494.notes: If Mindsplice Apparatus has more oil counters on it, the starting cost is reduced by {1} and you'll net infinite red mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2155-3259-7296.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
2155-3259-7296.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2155-3259-7296.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3263-4659-5003-7273.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Unlucky Cabbage Merchant, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, adding {C}{C}.
When Unlucky Cabbage Merchant dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Unlucky Cabbage Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Unlucky Cabbage Merchant enters, its first ability triggers, creating a Food token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Food, adding {C}{C}.
Unlucky Cabbage Merchant's second ability triggers. Holding priority, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve the Unlucky Cabbage Merchant trigger from step 5, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped. You will not shuffle Unlucky Cabbage Merchant as it's a new object.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

1495-4205-4613.description:
Activate Bloodthirsty Aerialist by using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Bloodthirsty Aerialist triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

225-5412-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
225-5412-5531-6621.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-5412-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 8 for the remaining triggers.
Repeat from step 1.

1987-2493-4276-4823.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2493-4276-4823.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Timeless Witness.
When Archaeomancer and Timeless Witness enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2493-4276-4823.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

413-3951-5703-5929.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
413-3951-5703-5929.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

186-3525-4758-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
186-3525-4758-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

413-803-1429-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
413-803-1429-5402.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Captain Storm trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1274-2741-3490-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2741-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2082-4186-5231.easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to Scurry Oak.
2082-4186-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature
2082-4186-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing any other creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Sadisitc Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

1621-5399.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Pirated Copy.
1621-5399.description:
Cast Pirated Copy by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Pirated Copy enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Pirated Copy. Choose to have Pirated Copy enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2034-2757-5081-5434.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic Forest.
2034-2757-5081-5434.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Obscuring Aether by paying {1}{G}, turning it face-down as a 2/2 creature.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Obscuring Aether, untapping the Forest.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Obscuring Aether, adding {C}{C}.
When Obscuring Aether dies, Yarus' second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down, then turning it face-up.
Repeat.

2178-4214-4312-4365.notablePrerequisites:
Utopia Mycon has at least three spore counters on it.
Thornbite Staff attached to Vorel of the Hull Clade.
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4214-4312-4365.description:
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Utopia Mycon.
Activate Utopia Mycon's first ability by removing three spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability twice by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {G}{U}.
When the Saporlings die, Vorel of the Hull Clade triggers twice, untapping it.
Repeat.
If Utopia Mycon has four or more spore counters on it to begin the combo, this combo nets infinite spore counters on Utopia Mycon, which you may remove for infinite Saproling tokens and/or colored mana, or target another creature using Vorel of the Hull Clade.

681-790-1368-2167.notablePrerequisites:
A player has at least six cards in hand, not including Windfall if its in your hand.
You control at least seven lands, of which one can tap to produce {U} and another can tap to produce {G}.
If Windfall is in your graveyard, you have three other cards in your graveyard excluding it and Splendid Reclamation if it's in your graveyard.
681-790-1368-2167.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing at least seven lands, adding {5}{G}{U}.
Cast Windfall either from your hand by paying {2}{U}, or from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{U} and exiling three nonland cards except Splendid Reclamation from your graveyard, causing each player to discard their hand and draw cards equal to the greatest number a player discarded this way.
Cast Splendid Reclamation from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {3}{G} and exiling three nonland cards except Windfall from your graveyard, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.
Depending on the number of cards in a player's hand and/or in your graveyard when Windfall resolves, you may be able to omit casting it during an iteration.

876-1308-1766-2043.description:
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Thran Dynamo that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Thran Dynamo token.
Activate the Thran Dynamo token by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3 using the other Thran Dynamo token.
Repeat from step 2.

186-1978-3660.notablePrerequisites: Millikin does not have summoning sickness.
186-1978-3660.description:
Activate Millkin by tapping it and milling a card, adding {C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {1}, untapping Millikin.
Repeat.

23-776-1329-4966.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Vandal do not have summoning sickness.
23-776-1329-4966.description:
Tap Orcish Vandal, sacrificing Chrome Mox to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Chrome Mox.
Cast Chrome Mox.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1518-1964-1987-2493.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1518-1964-1987-2493.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Archaeomancer, blinking them.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
